name: Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America (HMGMA) - Ellabell GA

fieldNotes.imagery: Available satellite imagery is from the construction phase (extensive bare earth, partly-finished buildings). HMGMA opened Oct 2024 with 16M+ sq ft of factory floor; the operational dock/trailer layout is not yet fully visible. Counts are best-effort estimates with low confidence — flagged accordingly.
fieldNotes.site: $7.6B EV manufacturing campus in Bryan County GA along I-16, ~25 mi west of Savannah. 16M+ sq ft factory floor across many connected/standalone buildings; 500K vehicles/yr capacity (IONIQ 5 / IONIQ 9 / Kia). The full HMGMA land parcel is ~2,900 acres; perimeter box covers the developed campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Facility of this scale and security profile has controlled, guarded gates. Street View (2025-11) along I-16 shows continuous perimeter fencing around the campus. Main entry road off Genesis Dr / the supplier corridor on the NW edge. truckGate = true (high confidence on existence).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true — a $7.6B OEM EV plant with fenced perimeter universally uses staffed security gates. Booth footprint not crisply resolvable in construction-phase imagery; flagged uncertain on exact structure.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large campus with 15+ distinct large buildings (multiple assembly/manufacturing halls, battery/SK On adjacent operations, admin/office buildings, supplier buildings on-campus). Clear multi-facility campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur/yard feature runs into the south part of the campus (visible at ~32.151,-81.452) — consistent with HMGMA's known rail-served finished-vehicle and inbound logistics design. railServed = true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts/component receiving and outbound finished-vehicle / shipping operate from separate parts of the campus on different building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved areas designated for trailer and finished-vehicle staging; in construction-phase imagery only partially occupied. Estimated 25-50 band, low confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: A campus this large uses separate in/out gates and a multi-gate truck routing system; entryExitSeparate = true (inferred).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Large secured OEM campuses typically run a perimeter gate plus a secondary internal checkpoint before docks; inferred true at low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Abundant paved width and undeveloped land at the entry corridors — physical room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural Bryan County — surrounded by pine woods and farmland.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.geofence: Center 32.1620,-81.4480. Perimeter box covers the developed campus footprint.
